title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: FV path exists, no valid output-contract evidence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: main.cpp:978–1016 applies alpha=0.1 reconstruction in steady path; transient :1363–1370 uses cell states. Report.tex:37–38,81–82 discloses alpha but asserts second order/all runs; selected historical run-source linkage unproved.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: main.cpp:991–1012 computes density/pressure limiter in steady path; transient :1363–1370 uses direct states. No verified limiter effectiveness for selected historical runs.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:981,1074–1075 scales viscous flux 0.01; gradient excludes wall faces :585, traction :759–766 is not tangentially projected. Report discloses scaling and Re20 Cd≈0.0006.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Final source :1189 onward contains LU-SGS sweeps, but selected v3 metadata reports diagonal_implicit; report claims all LU-SGS. Root-only gather :1292–1300 also impedes multi-rank steady completion.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Source :1393–1410 forms BDF2 residual with negative time term and tests inner ratio, but source link to selected v3 is unproved; selected forces decay monotonically, metadata claims periodic without valid shedding and no strict target counts.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS/halo paths exist, but full mesh retained on every rank; main.cpp:1292–1300 calls MPI_Gather only on root and :967–971 opens same CSV on all ranks. Selected np2/4/8 force files are empty; no validated force agreement.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
